howto.what: 装上后,Claude 通过 Chat SDK 把 Matrix 接入为聊天渠道,支持任意 Matrix 服务器,可收发房间与私聊消息;接入时需单独注册一个机器人账号并配置登录凭据。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Matrix 聊天渠道,或要求代理使用 Matrix 服务器收发消息时触发。

say.text: 把 Matrix 接入为聊天渠道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建。

say.text: 配置 Matrix 机器人账号
say.note: 会询问服务器地址、用户 ID 和登录方式。

say.text: 重新应用 Matrix 的 ESM 补丁
say.note: 修复构建时的模块找不到报错。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can integrate Matrix as a chat channel via Chat SDK, working with any Matrix homeserver, and exchange messages in rooms and DMs. A dedicated bot account and credentials are required.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Matrix as a chat channel or have the agent use a Matrix homeserver for messaging.

say_en.text: Add Matrix as a chat channel.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, and builds.

say_en.text: Set up the Matrix bot account.
say_en.note: Asks for server URL, user ID, and auth method.
